# API schemas

## subscriptionpostrequest



- `name` (required) — string. Subscription name. Example: `"Access request subscription"`
- `description` — string. Subscription description. Example: `"Access requested to site xyz"`
- `triggerId` (required) — string. ID of trigger subscribed to. Example: `"idn:access-requested"`
- `type` (required) — subscriptiontype. Subscription type. **NOTE** If type is EVENTBRIDGE, then eventBridgeConfig is required. If type is HTTP, then httpConfig is required. One of: HTTP, EVENTBRIDGE, INLINE, SCRIPT, WORKFLOW. Example: `"HTTP"`
- `responseDeadline` — string. Deadline for completing REQUEST_RESPONSE trigger invocation, represented in ISO-8601 duration format. Example: `"PT1H"`
- `httpConfig` — httpconfig. 
- `eventBridgeConfig` — eventbridgeconfig. 
- `enabled` — boolean. Whether subscription should receive real-time trigger invocations or not. Test trigger invocations are always enabled regardless of this option. Example: `true`
- `filter` — string. JSONPath filter to conditionally invoke trigger when expression evaluates to true. Example: `"$[?($.identityId == \"201327fda1c44704ac01181e963d463c\")]"`

## subscription



- `id` (required) — string. Subscription ID. Example: `"0f11f2a4-7c94-4bf3-a2bd-742580fe3bde"`
- `name` (required) — string. Subscription name. Example: `"Access request subscription"`
- `description` — string. Subscription description. Example: `"Access requested to site xyz"`
- `triggerId` (required) — string. ID of trigger subscribed to. Example: `"idn:access-request-post-approval"`
- `triggerName` (required) — string. Trigger name of trigger subscribed to. Example: `"Access Requested"`
- `type` (required) — subscriptiontype. Subscription type. **NOTE** If type is EVENTBRIDGE, then eventBridgeConfig is required. If type is HTTP, then httpConfig is required. One of: HTTP, EVENTBRIDGE, INLINE, SCRIPT, WORKFLOW. Example: `"HTTP"`
- `responseDeadline` — string. Deadline for completing REQUEST_RESPONSE trigger invocation, represented in ISO-8601 duration format. Example: `"PT1H"`
- `httpConfig` — httpconfig. 
- `eventBridgeConfig` — eventbridgeconfig. 
- `enabled` (required) — boolean. Whether subscription should receive real-time trigger invocations or not. Test trigger invocations are always enabled regardless of this option. Example: `true`
- `filter` — string. JSONPath filter to conditionally invoke trigger when expression evaluates to true. Example: `"$[?($.identityId == \"201327fda1c44704ac01181e963d463c\")]"`

## completeinvocationinput



- `localizedError` — localizedmessage. Localized error message to indicate a failed invocation or error if any.
- `output` — object. Trigger output that completed the invocation. Its schema is defined in the trigger definition. Example: `{"approved": false}`

## testinvocation



- `triggerId` (required) — string. Trigger ID Example: `"idn:access-request-post-approval"`
- `input` — object. Mock input to use for test invocation. This must adhere to the input schema defined in the trigger being invoked. If this property is omitted, then the default trigger sample payload will be sent. Example: `{"identityId": "201327fda1c44704ac01181e963d463c"}`
- `contentJson` (required) — object. JSON map of invocation metadata. Example: `{"workflowId": 1234}`
- `subscriptionIds` — array of string. Only send the test event to the subscription IDs listed. If omitted, the test event will be sent to all subscribers. Example: `["0f11f2a4-7c94-4bf3-a2bd-742580fe3bde"]`
